SELECT po.productId, pd.prodName, SUM(oi.quantity) AS salesQty, pd.price, pd.thumbnail FROM orderItem oi JOIN productOption po ON oi.optionId = po.optionId JOIN product pd ON po.productId = pd.productId JOIN orders od ON oi.orderId = od.orderId WHERE od.orderedAt >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -1)
GROUP BY po.productId, pd.prodName, pd.price, pd.thumbnail ORDER BY salesQty DESC FETCH FIRST 4 ROWS ONLY
SELECT productId, prodName, thumbnail, price FROM product ORDER BY regDate DESC FETCH FIRST 6 ROWS ONLY
